detail: Post-2026 Operating Guidelines Final EIS published + Federal Register NOA
3520.37 ft = 0.45 ft above all-time low, falling every day since 7/29 (~0.19 ft/d)
Aug releases 7,862 cfs = lowest of 9 yrs, -42.4% vs mean; measures the Powell->Mead coupling directly

USBR 919/49 primary confirms 3519.92 ft on 2023-04-13 as the post-1980 minimum; 2026-08-12 3520.37 ft ranks 6th-lowest, 0.45 ft above. 15 consecutive daily declines 7/29-8/12, mean -0.158 ft/d, range -0.11 to -0.23.

ACP primary re-checked: Advisories-to-Shipping index newest entry is A-46-2024 (FY2025 Dec); Notices-to-Shipping 2026 lists only standing N-01..N-13. No 2026 draft or transit RESTRICTION advisory published; no transit count published on either page.

4 of 6 tracked Rhine gauges are BELOW their published all-time low (NNW) at 17:45 CEST: WORMS -15 vs 2 (-17), KAUB 13 vs 25 (-12), DUISBURG-RUHRORT 134 vs 153 (-19), EMMERICH -11 vs -1 (-10). MAINZ 110 is exactly AT its 1947-11-02 record of 110 (7d min 109 = 1cm through). Only MAXAU is above (294 vs 231, +63). Benchmarks are the API's own NNW characteristic values, not carried figures.

Trigger station DUISBURG-RUHRORT at 134 cm, 19 cm below its all-time low of 153 cm (2018-10-23). Fell through the record inside this 7-day window: 8/06 max was exactly 153. 7d trend 145.4 -> 136.8 (-8.7 cm, -1.73 cm/d). Level+trend reported; trigger NOT graded - AEOLUS adjudicates.

The 25 cm 2018 Kaub benchmark is now verified AT the issuing agency, not carried: station metadata returns NNW=25.0 cm occurring 2018-10-22, and NW=25.0 cm for the 2010-11..2020-10 reference decade. Kaub current 13.0 cm = 12 cm below it, 64 cm below GlW 77 cm.

WSV publishes an official water-level FORECAST at /stations/<S>/WV/measurements.json (type=forecast, initialized 2026-08-13T07:00, ~4-day horizon). Available for KAUB, DUISBURG-RUHRORT, EMMERICH; HTTP 404 for MAXAU, WORMS, MAINZ. NOT listed in the station timeseries array (which shows only Q and W) - it is undiscoverable from metadata alone.

WSV 8/13 forecast to 8/17: KAUB dips to 6 cm (8/14-15) then recovers to 11 cm - a further fall then a partial rebound. DUISBURG-RUHRORT declines monotonically 135 -> 129. EMMERICH declines monotonically -10 -> -15. The binding shoal is forecast to stabilise; the two downstream stations are not.

Final EIS ExecSummary pulled: max shortage is a MATRIX by alternative, not a figure. Representative Preferred = 3.6 maf total / AZ 1.96 / CA 0.90 / NV 0.21. Trade-press triple (AZ .76/CA .44/NV .05) spans different columns and describes no alternative that exists; understates 2.0-4.2x. '1.5 maf 2027-28' is a distribution-METHOD breakpoint, not a cut volume

ACP Monthly Canal Operations Summary (numbered Advisory to Shipping) carries oceangoing transits daily average. A-14-2026 = 38.70/day (Apr-26), high 42 low 31. Anchors the previously unsourced '~36 normal'. Advisories INDEX is JS-rendered and silently stale - do not scrape it

OVF LKV ArcGIS service: 13 CONSECUTIVE Hungarian stations below their all-time LKV records, Vac km1679.5 -> Mohacs km1446.9 (233 km). Deepest Mohacs -40cm, Baja -31, Paks -23, Budapest -9. ALL those records set 2018-10-24/26 - the same drought week as the Rhine's

Rosario 3.02 m = 99th percentile of its 366-day trailing distribution (min 1.08, P10 1.40, median 2.14, max 3.03) - near the TOP of range, not mid-range as I first characterised it. Not firing, not near firing; a high Parana is GOOD for grain logistics
